Handling

Material handling services

Container unloading, palletizing, product sorting: a fast and reliable crew on the day you need, weekends included.

Get a quote 514-424-7936

The service in detail

A 40-foot container just arrived at your warehouse and it has to be emptied before the trucker leaves? A large order must be sorted and labelled before shipping? Groupe Gama provides experienced material handlers, in the numbers you need, for as long as it takes. We handle floor-loaded and palletized goods with care, at the pace your deadlines demand.

What’s included

  • Loading and unloading of 20- and 40-foot containers, floor-loaded or palletized
  • Palletizing, stretch wrapping and labelling
  • Sorting and order preparation
  • Crew sized to the job: 2 to 10 people
  • Available on weekends and holidays
  • Delivery of the pallets to your customers right after, if needed

How it works

  1. Describe the job

    Type of products, size and weight, approximate volume, location, and the container’s arrival date and time.

  2. We confirm the crew

    Number of people, estimated time and price; we bring pallet jacks and wrapping supplies as needed.

  3. Done on time

    Container emptied, goods stored or palletized, and transport arranged if you wish.

FAQ

FAQ — material handling services

How long does it take to unload a 40-foot container?

Floor-loaded, it usually takes 2 to 4 hours with a crew of 3 to 4, depending on the goods. Palletized is faster. We size the crew to your unloading window.

Do you supply pallets and stretch wrap?

Yes, on request. Just mention it in your quote request.

Can you come on short notice?

Often, yes — weekends included. Call us as soon as you know when the container will arrive.

Do you work in South Shore and Laval warehouses?

Yes, in every industrial area of Greater Montreal: Montréal-Est, Anjou, Saint-Laurent, Dorval, Laval, Boucherville, Longueuil, Vaudreuil and surrounding areas.
